name: Nicolas Assouad
description: Nicolas Assouad is Tech Lead at Spiko, which operates Europe's largest tokenized regulated funds infrastructure across more than five EVM networks, as well as Starknet, Stellar, and Solana. He builds the multi-chain infrastructure behind these funds, including the event archival system born from Spiko's regulatory obligation to keep fund history queryable even after a network shuts down, and authors Spiko's engineering deep-dives.
